title: Senior Software Engineer

**Location:**

**Position Summary**
Bentley Systems is seeking an exceptional Software Engineer to build industry-shaping platform capabilities, intelligent cloud services, AI-native development workflows, and products that transform how infrastructure professionals work. This is not a routine feature-delivery role. It is an opportunity to help create a next-generation, AI-enabled forms service that becomes a foundational layer for how infrastructure professionals capture field knowledge, coordinate decisions, and transform complex project activity into actionable intelligence across the Bentley Cloud Platform.
  
  
The right engineer will thrive on hard technical problems: designing resilient services, integrating AI agents into real engineering workflows, improving developer velocity, and building systems that matter far beyond a single product surface. You will not simply maintain software, you will shape a strategic platform capability that can influence how infrastructure is planned, built, operated, and improved around the world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and build the foundation for next-generation, AI-enabled forms workflows that turn field data, project activity, and human decisions into intelligent, actionable systems.
* Integrate AI agents into the development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, and redefine how high-performing teams build and operate software.
* Collaborate with a strong agile engineering team using modern continuous integration and delivery practices to ship reliable cloud platform capabilities quickly and safely.
* Translate ambiguous customer, product, and platform needs into crisp technical requirements, architecture decisions, and scalable implementation plans.
* Evolve and harden existing services so they become more resilient, observable, performant, secure, and ready for AI-augmented workflows.
* Design and deliver new platform features, services, and web experiences that solve complex collaboration challenges for infrastructure professionals at global scale.
* Operate in a fast-moving, AI-paced, DevOps-oriented environment where engineers own outcomes end to end, from design and implementation to deployment, telemetry, and continuous improvement.
* Integrate cloud services into a modern product architecture that supports scale, extensibility, reliability, and intelligent automation across the Bentley Cloud Platform.

**Qualifications**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience building production-grade software systems.
* 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing, delivering, and improving reliable services or products used in production.
* Experience building with AI agents, AI-assisted development workflows, or intelligent automation in production engineering environments.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills with C#, SQL, .NET Standard/Core, Git, and modern software development practices.
* Experience designing, building, and operating cloud services, REST APIs, and distributed service integrations.
* Knowledge of agile scrum development, test-driven development, continuous delivery, observability, and DevOps practices.
* Deep understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, system design tradeoffs, and advanced programming concepts.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and stakeholder groups.
* A rapid learner who can move from ambiguity to clarity, adopt emerging tools quickly, and use AI-enabled workflows to amplify personal and team productivity.
* High ownership mindset: self-directed, collaborative, pragmatic, and motivated to raise the technical bar for the team and platform.
* This role does not require travel.
* Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer (or any other physical requirements)
* Experience with TypeScript, Cosmos DB, cloud-native application patterns, or front-end platforms that support rich enterprise workflows.
* Experience with Microsoft development tools, unit testing frameworks, developer automation, or modern engineering productivity toolchains.

This is a Hybrid role.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are**
Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
Vistance Networks is a pioneering leader in the communications technology industry, dedicated to shaping the future of broadband and access network solutions. As part of Aurora Networks, formerly known as CommScope’s Access Networks Solutions segment, the company offers a comprehensive portfolio of innovative products designed to support global service providers. Vistance Networks is committed to delivering reliable, high-performance solutions that enable seamless connectivity in an increasingly connected world. With a global presence and a focus on innovation, the company fosters a dynamic environment where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to cutting-edge advancements in network technology.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our cable access engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with our US-based systems architects, software developers, and hardware engineers to develop and maintain firmware for next-generation Full Duplex (FDX) Cable Amplifiers and smart RF nodes. Your primary focus will be on designing firmware at the intersection of embedded Linux, Broadcom broadband SoC platforms, and dynamic RF control loops. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of our cable plant telemetry systems, leveraging modern protocols such as gNMI, Protobuf, and MQTT. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions that enhance connectivity worldwide, working in a collaborative environment that emphasizes technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Qualifications**
To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, along with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in embedded software or firmware development using modern C and C++. A strong understanding of RF fundamentals, including dynamic signal management and Automatic Gain Control (AGC) loops in amplified RF transmission paths such as DOCSIS or Cable TV plants, is essential. Experience working with Broadcom broadband SoCs and SDKs at both the register and hardware abstraction levels is highly preferred. Candidates should have deep expertise in embedded Linux driver development, Linux networking internals, and peripheral bus protocols like I2C, SPI, and UART. Familiarity with implementing telemetry and serialization protocols such as gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT for device management and real-time monitoring is also required. Excellent communication skills in technical English and experience collaborating effectively with US-based or distributed engineering teams are vital for success in this role.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, your responsibilities will include developing low-level firmware using Broadcom SDKs tailored for broadband and cable access SoCs to initialize, configure, and monitor RF hardware components. You will implement and optimize embedded control loops for RF functions such as AGC, ALC, tilt adjustments, and dynamic power management to ensure optimal RF amplification performance. Managing hardware interfacing and bus control over I2C, SPI, and GPIO interfaces is a key aspect of your role, including controlling on-board peripherals, RF attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and environmental sensors.
  
  
You will also be responsible for writing and maintaining custom Linux kernel drivers, character devices, and user-space daemons that interact directly with hardware registers and memory-mapped I/O. Architecting and implementing modern out-of-band management and telemetry systems using gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT will be essential for providing real-time health and RF performance metrics. You will participate actively in joint design reviews, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions with US-based firmware, RF hardware, and systems engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and performance. Additionally, performing hardware bring-up on custom Broadcom evaluation boards and production hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and RF spectrum analyzers will be part of your responsibilities, ensuring robust validation and troubleshooting of firmware and hardware interactions.
  
  
**Benefits**
Joining Vistance Networks offers an opportunity to be at the forefront of communication technology innovation. We provide competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, and opportunities for professional development and career growth. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages continuous learning, creativity, and the sharing of ideas. Employees gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and work on impactful projects that influence the future of connectivity worldwide. We also promote work-life balance and support flexible working arrangements to foster a healthy, productive workplace. Being part of Vistance Networks means contributing to solutions that bring reliable and high-performance connectivity to communities around the globe.
  
  
Equal Opportunity
  
  
Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values diversity and equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation and drives success, and we actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer, Autonomous Pentesting**

**Why this role exists**

A frontier model on its own is not a pentester. What turns a model into a capability you can run against a customer's app every day, and at scale, is the harness around it: how you feed it the target, scaffold its reasoning, give it tools, orchestrate cheap models against expensive ones, score what it produces, and stop it from shipping garbage. That harness is our core IP and our main lever on accuracy, coverage, and cost. You will own it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and productionize harnesses for autonomous pentesting across web, API, mobile, cloud, and more, taking each from a working prototype to something reliable against real customer targets.
* Orchestrate models against each other: use frontier models as the source of intelligence, then distill that into cheaper open-weight models so we can run at scale economically.
* Own evaluation. Define what a true finding is, measure recall and precision against ground truth, penalize false positives hard, normalize for cost, and control for run-to-run variance. If it is not measured, it does not ship.
* Push accuracy and coverage up, and cost and latency down, release over release.
* Build the guardrails that keep a hallucinated finding from ever reaching a customer, because one false critical costs more trust than ten real findings earn.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with our pentesters and researchers: turn their judgment into harness logic, and build tools that make them faster.

**What we're looking for**

* An engineer who ships. You write clean, scalable, flexible code, get a working slice out fast, then harden it. Prototypes that never reach production are not the job.
* Real LLM engineering: prompting and scaffolding, tool use and agents, orchestration across models, retrieval and context management, and a feel for where models break.
* Enough security depth to judge the output. You do not need to be a career pentester, but you must look at a finding and tell real from plausible-but-wrong, and reason about severity. Slop resistance is a core skill here.
* Evaluation rigor. You think in ground truth, baselines, false-positive rates, and cost per true finding, not vibes.
* Production instincts: observability, cost control, reliability, and the discipline to measure before and after every change.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on pentesting or offensive security across web, API, mobile, or cloud, CTF, or vulnerability research.
* Serving or fine-tuning open-weight models, or running them cheaply at scale.
* Mobile (Android or iOS) security, static and dynamic analysis, or reverse engineering.
* A track record of turning a messy research idea into something that shipped.

accordingly

title: Security Engineer
description:
About the role

NodGuard is a consent and data-protection platform built for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP). Catalysts is the company behind it. We are hiring a Security Engineer to set up security from the ground up and own it across both: the NodGuard platform on AWS, the DPDP breach and security features inside the product, and Catalysts' own systems and people.

You will be our first dedicated security person, so we are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, likes building things from scratch, and wants to grow with the company.

What you will own

•        
**Platform security.**
Harden NodGuard's AWS estate: IAM, network, encryption, key management, logging and alerting. Protect the data stores and keep every client's data isolated from every other's.

•        
**Secure releases.**
Put security gates into the build pipeline (dependency, secret and code scanning) so a risky change cannot ship.

•        
**DPDP breach features.**
Design how NodGuard detects, records and notifies personal-data breaches within the law's timelines, with tamper-evident evidence. Review every new feature for security before it ships.

•        
**Incident response.**
Be the incident commander. Write the plan, rehearse it, run it when needed, and write the report after.

•        
**Company security.**
SSO and MFA everywhere, device encryption and patching, same-day offboarding, plain-language policies, and security training for the team.

•        
**Compliance.**
Map our controls to DPDP, the DPDP Rules and CERT-In directions. Drive NodGuard towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Answer client security questionnaires.

•        
**Ownership.**
Keep the security roadmap, report monthly on what is protected and what is not, and help developers build security into their everyday work.

What you bring

•        4+ years in security, with real hands-on time in cloud security (AWS preferred) and application security.

•        You have hardened a production cloud environment yourself: IAM policies, VPCs, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, WAF.

•        You have handled at least one real security incident end to end.

•        You know the DPDP Act and Rules: breach notification, the Data Protection Board, Consent Managers. You know CERT-In's six-hour incident reporting rule.

•        You have set up SSO, MFA, device management and access reviews for a team.

•        You write clearly. Your policies and runbooks are followed by people who are not security experts.

•        You want ownership. You have worked somewhere small enough that you had to set things up from nothing.

**Good to have:**
experience with consent, ad-tech or martech platforms; mobile SDK and browser security; policy-as-code (OPA); ClickHouse or DynamoDB; SIEM and detection rules; answering enterprise security questionnaires in India.

Certifications

No certification is mandatory. Please list any security, cloud or privacy certifications you have completed (for example AWS Security Specialty, CEH, OSCP, CISSP, CCSP, CIPP/E, ISO 27001) in your application; they count in your favour.

Founder
